# Overview of Part 06: Machine Learning & Capstone

This final module brings together everything learned in Parts 01–05 to build, evaluate, and serialize production-ready machine learning and forecasting workflows:

1. **`01_supervised_ml_classification_regression.R`** — Leakage-free train/test scaling, $K$-fold cross-validation, Ridge ($L_2$) regularization, and binary classification metrics (Confusion Matrix, Precision, Recall, $F_1$, ROC-AUC).
2. **`02_unsupervised_learning_and_timeseries.R`** — Principal Component Analysis (`prcomp`), $K$-Means & Hierarchical Clustering (`kmeans`, `hclust`), STL Seasonal Decomposition, Holt-Winters, and Seasonal ARIMA (`arima`).
3. **`03_end_to_end_capstone_project.R`** — Complete FinTech Credit Default Risk pipeline from raw messy data to calibration lift tables and `.rds` model bundle serialization.

# Unsupervised Learning: PCA & K-Means Clustering

```{r pca-kmeans}
set.seed(42)
pca_fit <- prcomp(iris[, 1:4], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
km_fit  <- kmeans(scale(iris[, 1:4]), centers = 3, nstart = 25)

old_par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 3, 1.2))
plot(pca_fit$x[, 1:2], col = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")[unclass(iris$Species)],
     pch = 19, xlab = "PC1 (73.0% Var)", ylab = "PC2 (22.9% Var)",
     main = "True Iris Species in PCA Space")
plot(pca_fit$x[, 1:2], col = c("#e41a1c", "#377eb8", "#4daf4a")[km_fit$cluster],
     pch = 17, xlab = "PC1 (73.0% Var)", ylab = "PC2 (22.9% Var)",
     main = "Unsupervised K-Means (K = 3) Clusters")
par(old_par)
```

# Time-Series Decomposition & Holt-Winters Forecasting

```{r timeseries-forecast}
hw_model <- HoltWinters(AirPassengers, seasonal = "multiplicative")
hw_pred  <- predict(hw_model, n.ahead = 24, prediction.interval = TRUE, level = 0.95)

ts.plot(AirPassengers, hw_pred[, "fit"], hw_pred[, "upr"], hw_pred[, "lwr"],
        col = c("black", "#08519c", "#d95f02", "#d95f02"),
        lty = c(1, 1, 2, 2), lwd = c(1.5, 2, 1.2, 1.2),
        ylab = "Monthly Passengers (Thousands)",
        main = "AirPassengers 24-Month Holt-Winters Multiplicative Forecast (95% PI)")
legend("topleft", legend = c("Historical Actuals", "Forecast", "95% Prediction Interval"),
       col = c("black", "#08519c", "#d95f02"), lty = c(1, 1, 2), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

# End-to-End Production Checklist in R

1. **Data Hygiene & Split First**: Partition into Train / Validation / Test *before* computing imputation medians, scaling means/SDs, or target encodings.
2. **Cross-Validation**: Use $K$-fold or stratified/time-based rolling cross-validation to select hyperparameters ($\lambda$, tree depth, learning rate).
3. **Calibration & Lift**: Beyond raw ROC-AUC, evaluate predicted probabilities across risk deciles and compute the Brier score.
4. **Reproducible Artifact Packaging**: Bundle the fitted preprocessor parameters, model object, feature schema, and evaluation metrics into a versioned `.rds` artifact (`saveRDS`).
